summary: Tested BULKAPI admin-panel credentials (PUT /api/admin/live/credentials + status masks + token used by callbacks/launch) and Excel/CSV bulk game import, backend + frontend, plus full iteration_20 regression. Found and FIXED one critical bug: PUT /api/admin/live/credentials always returned 500 (KeyError 'token') on Python 3.11 because `locals()[k]` was used inside a list comprehension (comprehension has its own scope before 3.12). The keys were written to DB but the response 500'd and the cache was not refreshed. After the 1-line fix: new tests 9/9 pass, regression 16/16 pass, UI flows all pass.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent: 500 KeyError 'token' from audit_logs 'fields': [k for k in ('token','secret') if locals()[k]] (Python 3.11 comprehension scope). Replaced with [k for k, v in (('token', token), ('secret', secret)) if v].

minor.issue: The current server env token starts with http(s) (35 chars, ends '.php'), so it looks like a URL (probably the callback URL) and not a real API token. The env secret is 30 bytes, not 32. The new admin-panel check would reject this token value. Tell the user to enter the real token/secret in the admin panel.
If JWT_SECRET ever changes, Fernet decrypt raises InvalidToken, so every live endpoint (launch/callback/status) returns 500. Catch InvalidToken and fall back to env, logging an error.
There is no API/UI to clear the admin-panel keys and go back to the server env keys. The only way is a manual DB delete followed by a wait of 30s or a restart.
Provider length is not validated to at least 2 characters like GameIn (a 1-char provider is accepted). Imported games cannot have an image_id.

issues: The status card does not show 'source' (admin panel vs server), so the admin cannot tell which keys are active. Add a line such as 'Keys from: admin panel'.

action_items: Review the 1-line fix in bulkapi.py save_credentials (audit 'fields' list). Already applied and verified.
Optional: show the creds source in StatusCard, and add a 'Use server keys' reset action
Tell the user the current server env BULKAPI_API_TOKEN looks like a URL; they must enter the real token and the 32-char secret in the admin panel
critical_code_review_comments: locals() inside a comprehension breaks on Python <3.12 (fixed)
_CACHE is per process. Fine with --workers 1, but with multiple workers a save only refreshes the cache in one worker, so other workers can use stale keys for up to 30s
Verified: the Fernet-encrypted token/secret are not stored in plaintext in db.settings, and the API returns only masks (last 4)

success_rate.backend: 100% (25/25 after fix; credentials endpoint 0% before fix)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Cleanup done: db.settings bulkapi_creds deleted, TEST_ games, rounds, callbacks, sessions, LIVE- tx and bulkapi_credentials_updated audit logs deleted, demo promo_balance=1039, backend restarted. Verified status source='server' afterwards.
